findings.summary: One command does not orchestrate public metadata, source intake, anchors, packet composition, and approval gates end to end from only topic and seed.
findings.recommended_task: Add structured workflow-state and next-action output that guides the next exact command or gate without hiding approvals.
rerun_checks: PYTHONPATH=src pytest tests/integration/test_cli_commands.py -k 'survey_build or survey_packet or survey_anchors' -q

findings.summary: Packet is writer-facing but not prose-ready because ready_for_prose is false and supported_claim_count is zero.
findings.recommended_task: Add a claim-anchor mapping lane that keeps unsupported claims blocked until reviewed anchors exist.

findings.summary: Retraction, withdrawal, erratum, and version safety remain unchecked.
findings.recommended_task: Plan a bounded public status check surface; do not infer safety from metadata-only artifacts.
rerun_checks: approval-gated public status check or offline fixture negative, not Phase 0 local-only checks

findings.summary: The weakened-blocker negative case required repair; future harness changes need explicit expected-signal observation.
findings.recommended_task: Keep negative cases explicit in the summarizer and require expected signal observation.

findings.summary: Status says PASSED_PENDING_FINAL_REVIEW although final review body records agreement.
findings.recommended_task: Patch stale status or record why it remains pending.
rerun_checks: text consistency check in the feedback summarizer
